messages:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a full attention roulette sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S this morning. baseline model: llama-13b fp16, kernels: fused-attn, paged-flash, flash-variantC. seq lens: 128 / 512 / 2048 / 4096, batch sizes: 1/2/4/8. saw selector flip mid-run and a persistent tail on H100 at 2048+ when kv cache thrash hits.

ajay: can you paste the exact command + config? :thinking: curious if the batching policy changed during the run or if it was kernel-only.

maria: run command: `./bench_runner --model llama-13b --dtype fp16 --gpus H100,A100,L40S --seqs 128,512,2048,4096 --batches 1,2,4,8 --kernel-candidates fused,paged,flashC --kv-prefetch auto --warmup 200 --samples 500`

maria: short excerpt from perf profiler (H100, seq=2048, bs=2):
```
UI: kernel_selector -> paged-flash (0-120s)
UI: kernel_selector -> fused-attn (121-240s)
latency_p95: 310ms -> 780ms after switch
kv_cache_miss_rate: 3% -> 27%
GPU_util: 62% -> 48%
mem_spill_events: +12k
```

ci-bot: regression-alert: latency_p95 increase detected on h100 for seq>=2048 in last nightly sweep. linked run: 2123456789.

ryan: that pattern screams prefetch/evict policy oscillation. if paged-flash keeps pinning fragments then fused tries to avoid spills but forces full KV reloads when it flips back. did you capture KV heartbeat logs?

maria: yes — kv-heartbeat logs attached in the artifact. quick grep showed alternating large evict batches at ~2m intervals.

ajay: try forcing `--kv-prefetch off` for a short A/B. That should avoid noisy evictions at the cost of some extra token latency but may drop p95. also try stabilizing kernel decision by adding a hysteresis window (e.g., require 30s consistent perf before switching).

sophie: agree on hysteresis. also add a microbenchmark for mixed seq bursts (128->2048->128) to reproduce the flip faster. current sweep might hide transient oscillations.

maria: quick local A/B: kv-prefetch off reduced p95 from 780ms -> 420ms on H100 at seq=2048 but increased avg tokens/GPU slightly (~+6%). will run a full sweep overnight with hysteresis=30s.

ryan: good. if that proves stable we should: 1) tweak selector to prefer fused for long seqs on H100 unless mem_spill_rate < 1% 2) add prefetch backoff when evict rate > threshold 3) add metric alert for kernel churn (count switches/min).

ajay: thumbs up. can you also capture nvprof timeline for the worst run? we need kernel timings to reason whether fused's lowered util is from launches or mem overhead.

maria: will upload nvprof and timeline trace. plan: overnight sweep (A100/H100/L40S), hysteresis=30s, kv-prefetch off then on, and microburst test. will post artifacts and a short summary in morning.

ci-bot: scheduled job created: night-sweep-2123456789 (owner: maria).

sophie: thanks! if anything looks flaky ping me and i'll help instrument the selector logic. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — will report back with diffs and a perf log.
